children: Norwegian companies expect moderate output growth through the second half of 2026, with only minor changes in their outlook, a central bank survey showed on Thursday.
"Contacts point to improved household purchasing power, higher defence spending and data centre buildout as important growth drivers," Norges Bank wrote.

"At the same time, low construction activity is dampening growth... On the whole, contacts' growth expectations for the third quarter are little changed from the previous survey," the central bank said.
The business survey, which is key to monetary policy, was released one week before the central bank's next interest rate decision on September 24.
The survey was conducted between August 3 and September 3.
